items.period: Received Shuowen seal-script form; the depicted form is a modern vector redraw, not a dated artifact
items.caption: A modern redraw of the 歌 form labeled as Shuowen seal script. In the received dictionary analysis, 欠 is the semantic classifier and 哥 supplies the sound; the picture illustrates that received form, not an excavated inscription.
items.alt: A black seal-script style drawing of 歌 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: The Commons description explicitly identifies the form as 歌 in Shuowen seal-script style and states public-domain reuse; it illustrates the received 欠+哥 analysis. Its modern redraw status is made explicit.
items.rights: Public domain as stated on the Commons file description page.

limitations.text: The selected image is a modern vector redraw of a dictionary seal form, not a photograph or facsimile of an ancient artifact. No visually verified bronze inscription image was available in this research.
The Xiaoxuetang query page exposed no usable labeled glyph candidate through this browser; its general rights notice alone is not evidence for any particular form.
